messages.subject: tags$video blocks slider setting currentTime property
parts:
If I include in ui  

tags$video(id="vid1", width="500", src="HD.mp4", type="video/mp4", controls = T) 

or 

HTML('<video id="vid1" width="500"  controls>
          <source src="HD.mp4" type="video/mp4">
        </video>'
)

Then I able see and use controls to  play and pause the video, but slider managing  currentTime property does not work, as well as setting $("#vid1").currentTime property  via JS, though setting $("#vid1").playbackRate  works fine.

When I save the page as a static html file, then the slider works OK.
